name: Sikkim Treecreeper
rangeDescription: Himalayas of nepal to southern tibet and northwestern india
description: Dark treecreeper with a warm rusty tail, thin white brow and mustache, and a gray chest. Warm tones on the tail contrast sharply with the cooler brown on the back and wings.

name: Sulawesi Leaf Warbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern sulawesi
description: A dull warbler restricted to Sulawesi with a pale eyebrow, a largely blackish bill, dark legs, dingy olive-brown upperparts, and a pale yellow underside. No distinct wingbar.

name: Madagascar Yellowbrow
rangeDescription: Lowland rainforest of east-central madagascar
description: Medium-sized, dark tetraka with pale yellow underparts and a wide eye-stripe. Madagascar endemic of middle- and high-elevation rainforest.

name: Scarlet-breasted Dacnis
rangeDescription: Lowlands of far southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: A fantastic little bird that is nearly endemic to northwestern Ecuador, just barely reaching southwestern Colombia. Male’s blue, red, and yellow plumage and brilliant yellow eye are stunning in good light.

name: Yellow-billed Spoonbill
rangeDescription: Australia; vagrant to tasmania and new zealand
description: Large dull-white bird with a long, spoon-shaped bill. Plumage often appears dirty.

name: Indochinese Yuhina
rangeDescription: Northern plateau of thailand to southern china and northern indochina
description: A medium-sized, crested bird of both hilly and lowland forests. Brownish above and white below, with a white throat and brown cheeks.

name: Madagascar Buttonquail
rangeDescription: Madagascar; introduced (?) mauritius, réunion, and glorieuses
description: Tiny, complexly patterned quail-like bird. Female has rufous sides, gray underparts, and black facial markings.

name: Purple-throated Fruitcrow
rangeDescription: Tropical costa rica to northern bolivia, the guianas, and amazonian brazil
description: Large, mostly black bird found in the canopy of lowland forests. Male has wine-colored throat that can be puffed out expressively, but is often difficult to see in poor light.

name: White-collared Blackbird
rangeDescription: Himalayas of northern india to southeastern tibet, southwestern china, and northwestern myanmar
description: This aptly-named species has a bright white collar, which is its most notable field mark. Like most other blackbirds, males are predominantly black while females are dark brown.

name: Humaita Antbird
rangeDescription: Western amazonian brazil (east to the rio madeira), southeastern peru (eastern madre de dios), and northern bolivia (pando)
description: Understory antbird of wet, forested habitats. Males are evenly gray; females are warm brown.

name: White-naped Tit
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed semiarid thorn forest of western and southern india
description: The only strongly patterned, black-and-white tit in its range. The upperparts from forehead to tail are glossy black, with a prominent white patch on the lower nape and upper mantle.

name: Brown-headed Paradise-Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Southeastern new guinea (aroa river to waria river)
description: A long-tailed kingfisher of lowland and foothill forest. Brown head and back, orange underparts and rump, deep blue shoulder and long tail with narrow white tips.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Star-throated Antwren
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia to western paraná and northern rio grande do sul)
description: Very small active bird of the dense understory in humid forests. Short-tailed with a cinnamon head, back, and vent, and a gray face and belly.

name: Stierling's Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Southern tanzania to northern mozambique and southern malawi; eastern zambia?
description: A medium-sized woodpecker with pale underparts that are covered with dark arrow-shaped markings. Has a bold facial pattern: crown is dark in the female and dark (forecrown) and red (hindcrown) in the male.

name: Waved Albatross
rangeDescription: Breeds española (galapagos) and isla la plata off ecuador
description: Large and gangly seabird that nests only in Galápagos and on Isla de la Plata (a small island near Ecuador’s central coast). When not breeding, it disperses over the eastern Pacific Ocean as far south as Chile.

name: Masked Cardinal
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia (southward to northern meta and eastern vichada), venezuela (except far southern) and trinidad
description: Unmistakable tricolored bird, with bold red, black, and white patches. Red hood and throat, black mask, mostly black back and tail, and white underparts.

name: Mindoro Bleeding-heart
rangeDescription: Forest of mindoro (central philippines); status unknown
description: A very rare medium-sized ground dove of lowland and foothill forest floor on Mindoro. Iridescent bluish on the head and back of the neck, with a purplish back, a blackish wing with white triangular marks on the shoulder, a white throat and underparts, and a small red “bleeding heart” in the center of the chest.

name: Ampay Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Andes of south-central peru (apurímac)
description: Dark gray tapaculo with a pale eyebrow known only from a few sites in the eastern Andes of southern Peru. While long known to be something different, it was finally described as a new species in 2020.

name: Rio de Janeiro Antbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia and eastern minas gerais to rio de janeiro)
description: Medium-sized gray antbird with a long tail. An inhabitant of the understory of dense humid forest.

name: Mangrove Swallow
rangeDescription: Lowlands of northern mexico to panama
description: Small swallow of tropical lowlands. Usually near water, from mangroves and coastal lagoons to rivers well inland; mainly in small groups, often mixed with other species of swallows.
